note: ADR-0011 §3.2 first bars. A gain modulator: linear and time-varying, so no THD or aliasing bar applies (the soft-square shape is a smooth tanh(4 sin) whose sidebands fall off with the harmonic order). Measured on a DC input so the output is the gain itself: range [1 - depth, 1] for every shape (range_err), period against 1 / rate (period_err), the two channels' gains summing to 2 - depth at full spread (spread_err), the auto-pan's gains keeping gL^2 + gR^2 = 2 (pan_power_err) and reaching 0 and sqrt(2) at the extremes (pan_range_err), and depth 0 leaving the signal bit-exact (unity_err).
